title: Chapter 76: Attacking The Supply Line
content:
Chapter 76: Attacking The Supply Line

"Lord! We have strayed far from the planned route. Do we need to take a detour?"

The Tengu guide was almost dizzy and had lost his way.

[Remember the domain name of this site: Taiwan Novel Network → 𝓉𝓌𝓀𝒶𝓃.𝒸ℴ𝓂]

He was just pretending to be a guide. In fact, the Zerg in front were leading the way.

"Continue to take a detour. The evil god army must be ready now. We must attack from the most unexpected position to complete the mission!"

Wu Qing did not lie to the guide. He really decided to continue to complete the seemingly impossible mission. If he made a fuss about this mission, it might immediately trigger a war between the two camps.

Wu Qing was taking a detour to accurately avoid the enemy's search and interception, waiting for the Zerg reinforcements to arrive.

Without sufficient reinforcements, the alliance army would plunge into the enemy's encirclement and could easily get stuck.

Wu Qing would not underestimate the strength of the evil god army. Those sacrifices alone were enough to give him a headache.

The alliance army defeated some weak evil god armies, which would not make him unclear about the gap in strength between the two sides.

Relying on Wu Qing's information advantage and the speed of the Zerg dogs to clear the scouts of the evil god army, the alliance army continued to play hide-and-seek with the increasing evil god army.

Until the number of puppies coming from the Zerg territory reached 10,000, Wu Qing directly rushed to the busy supply line behind the evil god army camp through the route he had chosen long ago.

From the direction of the Zerg territory, nearly 200 puppies came almost every two minutes, and the total number of Zerg troops was still increasing rapidly.

Now the Zerg needs more resources to support the continuous surge of troops.

The small scouts and patrol teams around the evil god army camp were beaten by the puppies that could burrow into the ground and lurk, and they dared not appear again. Only the large-scale evil god believers dared to search and block this area.

Under Wu Qing's command, the alliance army dodged left and right and finally successfully arrived near the supply line of the evil god army.

On a wide road, there was an endless stream of transport teams coming and going, and even an organized army of evil god believers rushed to the evil god army camp through this road.

On both sides of the road, at intervals, there were patrol teams patrolling back and forth, and in the distance, you could see organized garrison troops.

"Tell me, where was the battle yesterday?"

Sitting on the giant tiger, Meng looked down at the Tengu guide on the back of the giant lizard and asked.

"I, I don't know!"

The Tengu guide began to stutter under Meng's momentum.

"Don't embarrass him."

Wu Qing smiled.

"Whether they fight or not, we must fight here today!"

"Let's study together and see how to cause the greatest damage to the enemy!"

"Don't worry, I have prepared a retreat for everyone!"

Everyone was used to Wu Qing's laughter at this time, and they were very confident in the strength of the Zerg.

"Destroy the enemy's living forces as much as possible! Destroy the enemy's supplies and transportation tools! What else is there to study? Just do it!"

Meng was a warmonger who was not afraid of anything when he went to the battlefield. He felt that the people and things on this road were valuable, and he would not lose no matter how he fought. He was a little impatient.

"That's right, we will be exposed here soon, and there is no time for us to choose a target!"

"Then we will start from here, follow this road, and attack all the way away from the enemy's base camp!"

Since there was nothing to discuss, Wu Qing only decided on a direction to attack.

Wu Qing and Meng knew that attacking this supply route had more symbolic significance than practical significance, unless they were very lucky and happened to encounter a large transport team carrying important supplies.

But the defense of such a transport team is very strong, and ordinary troops cannot attack it.

"The enemy's missing scouts and patrol teams have attracted attention, and they are ready to launch an attack!"

After a simple rest and energy replenishment, the elite troops of the Alliance Army have become full of energy and high morale.

They have lined up in the charge formation and are ready to go.

"Attack!"

At Wu Qing's command, the Zerg puppies, who had long been unable to hold back, rushed to the busy avenue ahead like a black torrent.

"Enemy attack! Enemy attack!"

"Howl!"

The patrol team responsible for guarding the supply line discovered the incoming puppies at the first time. They shouted enemy attack and fired warning flares to indicate the attack.

The supply avenue fell into chaos, and the nearby patrol teams and garrisoned troops heard the news and rushed over here.

But in the face of the speed of the Zerg puppies and the Alliance Army, their actions were still too slow.

The puppies rushed past, drowning the patrol team blocking the road, and killed the people and supplies on the supply avenue.

All the people of various races in the evil god camp were fanatical believers of the evil god. They had lost their normal humanity and would not feel any psychological burden when killing them.

The puppy rushed to the road, waving his blade, and chopped the people and materials on the road into pieces, which was a horrible sight.

Fortunately, the dead people would disappear in light, so the scene was not so bloody and terrifying.

Among the destroyed materials, there were edible materials, and the puppies were not polite, opening their ferocious mouths and eating them all at once.

Everything that the Zerg eats will be converted into energy, so there is no problem of waste.

If a Zerg with sufficient energy dies, the energy will not be wasted, and it will be brought back when it returns to the system.

So the Zerg can eat as much as they want, eating can increase their continuous combat time, and the remaining energy can be recycled, without any waste.

For those combat supplies that cannot be eaten, the puppy will use its sword arm that can cut gold and iron to chop them one by one.

The supply road looks endless, but in fact, within a limited range, there are not many people and supplies that can be carried, which is not enough for tens of thousands of puppies to rush.

Under Wu Qing's command, the puppies split into two groups and rushed in the front and back directions of the road.

The elite troops of the alliance and the Zerg Hydralisks can only follow the puppies and eat dust.

"Go east along the road!"

"We are chewing hard bones! The enemy has not reacted yet! Everyone gather strength! Prepare to attack!"

Meng loudly encouraged the morale of the elite troops of the alliance.

Originally, everyone was in high spirits and wanted to kill the enemy, but now they found that there was no enemy to kill, which affected their mood a little. They needed warriors like Meng to speak out.

On the battlefield, Meng was the leader, Yu Chong and Bai Yan were the deputies, responsible for the specific command of the 5,000 elite troops of the Alliance.

Wu Qing was mainly responsible for commanding the operations of the Zerg troops, as well as the formulation of the strategy and various tactics of the entire Alliance army.

The supply avenue was more tightly guarded in the direction of the base camp of the evil god army. The dogs rushing in this direction soon encountered a well-organized blockade.

Wu Qing sent 2,000 Hydralisks over to use powerful long-range firepower to clear this small group of blocking troops.
